items.briefing:
A new survey shows Australian and New Zealand small and medium businesses are increasingly open to using AI in their cyber security, but many still don't fully trust AI-driven tools to make decisions without human oversight. This reflects a broader caution worth keeping in mind as AI features appear in more everyday business software. Separately, a newly discovered vulnerability called "Certighost" affects Microsoft Active Directory certificate services, which many organisations use to manage user access — if your IT team hasn't reviewed this yet, it's worth raising.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT provider or helpdesk whether your organisation uses Microsoft Active Directory certificates, and whether the Certighost vulnerability has been patched.

featured.title: ANZ SMEs back AI in cyber security, but trust lags
featured.quote: ANZ SMEs lack trust in AI for cybersecurity despite widespread adoption of the technology.
